lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 vertical white lines of varying intensity; spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-section with higher contrast in the central segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple lines, particularly those closest to the shoulder and the posterior haunch, appear as abbreviated segments or dashed lines that do not span the full vertical height of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct white spots are visible on the lateral posterior haunch; one primary spot located mid-haunch and a smaller, less intense spot located inferiorly.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate curvature, originating from the skull with a posterior angle before twisting dorsally and medially.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 0.7 relative to the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.other_distinctive_markers: Visible white facial markings include a chevron between the eyes and two spots on the lower cheek; limbs show a sharp transition to ochre-orange below the knees and hocks.
